title: Be wary of this bank and their fraudulent practices
body:
Avoid this bank at all costs. There are much better banks in the UAE that offer much better terms and treat their customers a lot better. Mashreq refuses to cancel my credit card, citing fees that were mentioned nowhere in the app. They claim that these fees are in their terms and conditions on their website, but I never used the website. Currently they're hijacking 25,000 AED while giving 0.15% interest on it (a joke basically) as a collateral for 9,000 AED credit card. If this is not customer deception and theft, I don't know what is. I have moved nearly 1 million AED away from this bank. Banks like Wio will decimate dinosaurs like Mashreq.
I'm still unable to get my money back. They're acting as if the account doesn't exist. Keep your money away from this bank.

The common thing they say is I have sent an email to the upper level people who have frozen your account so I will be in contact with you after 24 hrs or 2 to 3 days and I always say okay I will wait hoping that my issue will be solved and I will be able to withdraw my money. Why don’t the costumer service or whoever I contacted didn’t tell the truth about my issue and when will I be able to get my money. title: Very unprofessional and poor security
body:
I used this account more then 2 years, but I was shocked when I saw automatically 424.91AED deducted when I got my salary then next day when I wakeup I saw 2 time is deducted my money first time 279AED and second time 147.99 AED it means total 851.9AED. That time i went to nearest Mashreq bank branch (Burjuman branch), they didn’t help me, they just told me talk to customers care, Then I called to customer care, they told me 424.91 AED is deducted for global issues, then I asked which type of global issues, they told me before they didn’t deduct my money for transaction that’s why they deducted my money for 14 transaction…. I just thinking per transaction they cut more then 30 AED wow nice.. and I asked again why you cut my money 2nd and 3rd time, they told me I was purchases something from apple.com that time I was check there is not any purchase. Then I told her (customers care) I didn’t purchase anything they just block my card and send me new card, and they send me 1 dispute from and told me fill-up it and send me. And they told me they will investigation about my account, But still now I didn’t get any information about my money… and this is which type of security??? How they deduct my money without OTP or info me….. it’s very poor security and very unprofessional bank… if I will not get my lost money-details either i will complain to police about this issue. 
Thank you…..

title: Real Disapointment
body: As a customer of Mashreq Bank who recently settled a loan, I've been deeply disappointed with their services. Aside from encountering substantial delays in issue resolution due to poor communication between departments and high fees for settling the loan, I've also experienced frustration with their customer service process. When opening a case through their application, they often mark it as solved without providing any updates or resolutions, leaving the issue unresolved. Whether contacting them via phone or visiting in person, the lack of follow-up and accountability only exacerbates the situation. I truly hope to see significant improvements in their customer service approach to ensure a more efficiency and transparency.

The mashreq neo app isn’t working and redirects you to the main mashreq app. The main app literally NEVER works. Not even once has it worked. Its always having maintenance issues or error logging in. What is going on with this bank and their apps? Horrible service. Would not recommend.
